header.name: InvUI for Bedrock Resource Pack (EXPERIMENTAL / UNVERIFIED)
header.description: EXPERIMENTAL TEMPLATE. NOT VERIFIED IN-GAME. The pack version [0,1,0] and min_engine_version [1,26,70] are placeholders; the matching game version is unconfirmed. How this pack is applied (activation, load order, and the ui/_ui_defs.json registration) is also unverified. Test only in a disposable world with backups. This pack does not modify vanilla chest screens and provides no item protection.
